feature: In-game performance diagnostics overlay, enabled initially, F9 toggle

implementation.host: Read-only GetProcessTimes/GetThreadTimes + Toolhelp thread list once/second. Top4 OS thread IDs sorted by CPU time, 100 percent per logical processor; total process percent normalized by logical count. No suspension, affinity changes or input injection.
implementation.gpu: PDH GPU Engine Utilization Percentage filtered to current PID, ALL engine types; display maximum valid engine plus engtype name. The initial 3D-only filter missed Graphics_1 and incorrectly suggested no GPU usage.
implementation.graphics: AuroraStats plus sampled elapsed host time in CPU-side rendering stages, including waits. Inclusive estimated ms/s, not CPU execution time and not GPU timestamps. Draw assembly is unmerged path only, not renderer total.
implementation.gpu_timer_limit: WebGPU GPU timestamp queries not instrumented; UI explicitly says GPU milliseconds unavailable.
implementation.controls: F9 toggle; draggable closable diagnostic window; no gameplay button automation.

host_busy_fixture.result: PASS; distinguishes one occupied logical CPU from process total.

gpu_external_probe.limit: Live values zero during this particular interval; do not infer GPU busy time or stable gameplay performance from this probe.

user_gameplay_screenshot.result: Strong serial CPU bottleneck; screenshot does not show all CPU capacity used.

gpu_all_engine_probe.result: Explains incorrect zero from initial3D-only filter; no driver/global GPU utilization assumption.

corrected_live.result: Corrected overlay verified visually and host log; no automated input.

latest_user_gameplay.result: Serial CPU bottleneck persists; overlay correction did not redistribute execution.

saturated_thread_followup.external_note: Nearest DLL exports identified repeated CRT getenv and locks; closest export is not a validated unwind.

gameplay_fps_issue: remains open; feature is diagnostic, not a claimed speed fix

followup_candidate.change: Copy launch-time diagnostic environment values once per call site in Aurora common/command_processor. Preserves absent/empty/value distinction and captured file paths. Avoid per-draw Windows CRT environment lock. Gameplay pipeline and exact source validation unchanged.

microbenchmark.method: No-inline wrappers with volatile guard prevent loop-hoisting getenv. Same absent-value result. Earlier hoisted benchmark discarded.
microbenchmark.limit: Isolated overhead only; no live FPS improvement claim.

followup_candidate.next: Combine/validate performance changes at next appropriate restart; no repeated manual load requested for this alone.
